222-527-6633-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6633-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-4518-5434-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4863-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4863-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
4863-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

654-1308-4094-7824-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-1308-4094-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

225-851-3129-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-851-3129-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Repeat.

330-5430-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.

330-5430-7839.description:
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Jaya, Venerated Firemage.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

7297-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
7297-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
7297-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

586-997-5258-5618-7646.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

475-4186-4321-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-4186-4321-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1879-2049-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2049-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-7124-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
2511-7124-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2511-7124-7358.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

2068-2762-4659-5346.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability twice by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from it, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Thopter, adding {C}{C},
Crime Novelist triggers, causing you to add {R} and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thopter Squadron's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the other Thopter token.
Ashnod and Crime Novelist trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ashnod trigger, copying Thopter Squadron's ability.
Resolve both Thopter Squadron abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on it,.
Repeat.

478-6871-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control four or more creatures.
478-6871-6984.description:
Activate Evendo, Waking Haven by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Evendo, Waking Haven and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6556-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6556-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

276-1640-3011.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
276-1640-3011.notablePrerequisites:
Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness
At least one opponent has an even life total
You have an odd life total
276-1640-3011.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah's Shield.
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal damage to each player equal to half their life total, rounded down, then doubled.
Each player who started with an even life ottal loses the game for having 0 or less life.
276-1640-3011.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

4186-5070-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-5070-6824.description:

When the creature token enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Ajani's Welcome triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on it.
Defiant Greatmaw's second ability triggers, removing a -1/-1 counter from another creature you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1
Repeat.

5670-6291-6634.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6291-6634.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1874-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1874-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

1558-3618.notablePrerequisites:

Ognis triggers five times, creating five tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing the Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

354-2593-4222.notablePrerequisites: Astral Cornucopia does not have summoning sickness and has at least two charge counters on it.
354-2593-4222.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Lifecraft Awakening by paying {1}{G}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Astral Cornucopia and causing it to become a 0/0 Construct artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, attaching it to Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

678-710-876-2034-4445.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Danitha.
Activate Danitha by tapping it, adding {4}{W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Danitha to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Danitha by paying {4}{W}.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Leyline Immersion onto the battlefield from your graveyard attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

5-1636.notablePrerequisites:
Oviya does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}{G}.
5-1636.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}.
Activate Oviya's first ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}, this combo produces infinite mana.

803-1869-2232-3821.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1869-2232-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it, Cloudstone Curio and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake with haste.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.

1409-2557-2564-4231.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
1409-2557-2564-4231.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability and Lonis.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating two Clue, two Food, and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and any other creature.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1475-2034-4535.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-2034-4535.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
The Spirit tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Good-Fortune Unicorn that many times, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Spirit token.
Repeat.
